hero_lede: Auto repair done right. Call and we will take a look.
coverage_h2: Boone (Watauga), and the towns around it
quote_h2: Tell us what you need done
footer_blurb: A J's Tire & Auto serving Boone (Watauga).
about_p1: We handle auto repair for drivers who need it done right.
area_h2: We work in and around Boone (Watauga)
svc_hero_h1: The auto repair work we take on

reviews.author: FRANK EVERETT
reviews.text: While visiting the Boone NC area I had a leaking tire on my car and went to Discount Tire and they refused to repair it and tried to sell me a new tire which wasn’t the correct size. Next on to Mr Tire who also refused to repair my tire however the technician there said try A Js. Mechanic there stopped what he was working on and found the nail that caused the leak and patched it I was on my way in less than 15 minutes with a very reasonable charge of $20 Great people there! Thank goodness independent repair shops still exist!

reviews.author: Ashley Robinson
reviews.text: I highly recommend this place! They were able to get me in same day for a brake and rotor replacement on all 4 tires. They were trustworthy and reasonable compared to others in the area. Will definitely be going back for any future work needed.

reviews.author: Joseph Pierce
reviews.text: Great place, great people! Terry was very helpful from start to finish. Got tires ordered for me, made the appointment, and completed the job. Great overall experience from start to finish Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Doug Arcure
reviews.text: AJ's completed a brake job on my 2008 Jeep Wrangler. Less than 10k miles on the Jeep and I had to completely redo both the front and rear breaks. The car was not drivable when both the front and rear breaks failed at different times so I couldnt Drive 2 hours to AJs from where I live to have them fix their issue. I would Not recommend using AJs.

reviews.author: Holly Ogle
reviews.text: I went to AJ's after being referred to them by a trusted friend after I had an incredibly unpleasant experience with another mechanic near Roan Mountain. AJ's repaired the A/C on my vehicle and let me supply the parts. AJ, Bryan, and Terry treated me with respect and courtesy, and answered every question I had (and I had many).

reviews.author: Katelyn Grace
reviews.text: The mechanics are so wonderful and helpful. I got a nail in my tire and was in a rush to get home to Charlotte, but couldn’t drive all the way home on a spare. They were booked out all day, but he was able to fit us in and give us a plug on the tire. Very fair price and super helpful!!!

reviews.author: Daemon Salvatore (Rev. Couch)
reviews.text: Super friendly staff. Guys are great at what they do. I got in town just before 5 pm and needed my tired plugged, badly. Megan at the front was so kind and sweet. She took me in and had the guys fix my tire, even though it put them a few minutes past 5 pm, being able to close. The guys were quick and efficient and got my tire fixed, and I was back on the road in less than 20 minutes. This quick service meant the world to me because in my world, time is money. If you need tire service, AJ's is THE place to go.

reviews.author: Zada
reviews.text: Had a surprise popped tire and these guys saw me in the hour, and fixed it in 5 minutes. It's nearly impossible to get into a mechanic in Boone within the week and these guys solved my stress in 5 minutes and $25. Absolute respect and care.

reviews.author: Kirsten T
reviews.text: Stopped by with a brand new tire gone flat. He put on the lift,found the screw, plugged it and we're on our way back to Raleigh. Couldn't have asked for better, faster service!

reviews.author: Terri Mitchell
reviews.text: I needed a small repair done on my front bumper so I stopped at AJ's. This wonderful man, Terry, came out with a screwdriver and had things fixed in 10 minutes. I offered to pay but there was no charge. There's a reason this place is always busy.

reviews.author: Douglas Fowler
reviews.text: AJ, Terry, and the whole crew at AJ's Tire & Auto are top notch people and masters of their field. They've always been prompt to finish my repairs, and answer any of my questions. They've made a loyal customer of me for sure!

reviews.author: Brett Williams
reviews.text: Called for an inspection and got an appointment the next day. In and out in less than 20 minutes. Every customer interaction I witnessed was pleasant. Megan was a sweetheart. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Christie Rhoad
reviews.text: Just wanted to give a shout out. My App State daughter is trying to drive back to Raleigh after Helene devastated Boone. Her check engine light came on. AJ owner met her at the shop, ran diagnostics and added oil. And only charged her $8 for the oil. He really just cared about getting her back home, not charging for any of his time. Very nice human!

reviews.author: Valentyna Semenova
reviews.text: I needed an inspection for my registration and they were able to work me in same day, they were very efficient and kind. I had to return because I gave them the wrong registration and again, they worked me in same day and finished quickly.

reviews.author: Timothy Bittinger
reviews.text: I trust no one else in Boone more to take good care of my car needs. Their staff is always so friendly and helpful. If you're stressing over an issue with your car, they are patient and help you calm down because they know what they are doing and how to make things work out for you. You do need to call in an appointment as they tend to get booked up pretty quickly, but they are honest and never try to make you get work your car doesn't need. Their prices are pretty reasonable too and you can expect them to get things done quickly.

reviews.author: Sydney
reviews.text: Every time I come in for an inspection or oil change I am never let down by their service. They NEVER try to pressure me into spending more money on services like many other auto places around Boone do, and their customer service is always amazing! 10/10 would recommend!!

reviews.author: Lorraine Wenner
reviews.text: I came to this car repair shop during a trip to Blowing Rock today having an issue with a mid guard dragging below my car. I was taken care of right away, my car was put on the lift and the repair was made. It was a minor repair and I was on and out in 10 minutes. The best news - no charge! I definitely recommend this repair shop in Boone! I’m

reviews.author: deidre shæ
reviews.text: Fastest car inspection I have ever had. I made an appointment for 4pm and got there 5 minutes early. They immediately took in my car, and at 4:01pm, I paid and was out the door. Fast and efficient!

reviews.author: Noah Sheir
reviews.text: An excellent shop. Had a misdiagnosed issue from a mechanic out of state, brought it to AJ's and they diagnosed my car right in front of me in just a couple minutes, even showing and explaining the issue to me. Nice employees who are there to help. I would highly recommend if you're in Boone to take your car to AJ's. They will treat you right and are skilled at what they do!

reviews.author: Dallas Parker
reviews.text: Awesome people and great service, and no sketchy business! I have been using their garage for two years now, and they are always upfront and helpful. They answer all of my questions and explain the work done to my vehicle every time. Even when I have taken my vehicle in just to have something looked at, they were prompt and didn't charge me. That is the way a good business is run. Thanks, guys!

reviews.author: Margaret
reviews.text: On the last day before my son's registration expired AJ kindly fit him in his incredibly busy schedule and got the inspection done in record time plus replaced the 4 tires as needed to pass inspection - all in record time - and less than it would have cost at any other dealer! Everyone there is very friendly and trustworthy. I wouldn't go anywhere else!

reviews.author: Shannon Rosenberger
reviews.text: First off I would like to say that the staff and service center is beyond amazing. Don't bother getting a quote from anyone else... They have the best prices and they want return customers. That is what they have with me. After quoting 31 places on tires... they beat everyone out. I had to have over $1000 worth of work done on my car. They not only did it in a timely fashion, but they did a great job as well. I would recommend this shop to anyone and everyone!!! They truly do the best job for the best price. If you are a girl, most shops try and get some over on you... not Aj's. Thank you so much for everything! I will be back don't you worry :)

reviews.author: Michael Nader
reviews.text: My daughter goes to school in Boone and she has taken her car there twice and both times these guys have diagnosed the car correctly, quickly and at most reasonable rates. I am so happy to know that there is a reliable mechanic near my child who won't try to overcharge me. Thank you

reviews.author: Derek Leighton
reviews.text: AJ’s will always take care of you. They’re not like your dealership or corporate body shop. They won’t try to sell you on things you don’t need and they always go above and beyond while taking care of your vehicle. Been here multiple times and never had a bad experience. This is the only place to go in Boone.

reviews.author: Winn Williams
reviews.text: Made an appointment in person and they scheduled me for Memorial Day. I double checked and asked if they would be open and the mechanic confirmed. No phone call letting me know and they were closed during the appointment time. Terrible service, would not recommend.

reviews.author: Brianna Mintz
reviews.text: Super friendly people! Helped me with my car inspection and it took less than 20 minutes! (I have been to four other places in boone that refused)

reviews.author: dnletoile
reviews.text: 2016 Jeep Renegade 41,000. Check Engine light. Stopped at Advance Auto for diagnostic, P0481 problem with cooling system. Son-in-law recommended shop he uses. Very fast repair involving replacing fan assembly. Jeep was ready in one day and operates great. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Reginald Wilburn
reviews.text: I had a daughter at App State with a fuel pump issue. Travis and his staff were easy to work with, affordable and allowed me to purchase my own fuel pump to save on parts. They didn't try to up sell me on anything. An overall good experience considering the circumstances. I would highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Shane Heidinger
reviews.text: We had our alternator go out while in Boone for a wedding and AJs helped us out, got us in right away and replaced it that same day! Super helpful and friendly. Trying to find a good car shop while in a town you are unfamiliar with is stressful, but AJs was great!

reviews.author: Mason Webb
reviews.text: got me in last minute for an emergency plug on my tire. extremely fairly priced, polite, and super quick service as well.

reviews.author: Doug M.
reviews.text: I'd give them 10 stars if I could. My son's car "died", so I had it towed to A J's. (He's an App student, and fortunately a friend who lives in Boone referred us to them) It would have been extremely easy for them to make up a story about what was wrong and charge us accordingly. Instead, they quickly found the problem, which turned out to be insignificant. They only charged an hour labor, and the car run's great. I hope the car has no further issues while my son is in school, but if it does, I won't hesitate to have him take it to A J's.

reviews.author: Allison Kreidt
reviews.text: Took my car in before moving to a new state to make sure it would be in great condition over the long drive. They recommended changing my brake pads and then also called again about my calipers. Well, now I’m in Colorado and the brake pads used are so cheap that they caused a huge build up of brake dust and are wearing out insanely fast to the point I have to get them replaced again. Also tell me how I spent $1,200 on this fix in Boone and now it’s only $250 at my dealership for new pads... just super sketchy. Not to mention I heard squeaking in my brakes and took my car back in before I left boone and they told me nothing was wrong when OBVIOUSLY there was something majorly wrong. I always feel like I get irrationally persuaded at chain companies like Mr. Tire but honestly wish I had just gone there anyways or took the drive home to Raleigh for my dealership.

reviews.author: Hanna Love
reviews.text: Quick, affordable and friendly service. I got a flat tire over the weekend so this morning I called Bill's to see how much it would be to fix it and they told me $45...I thought that was expensive but maybe that was the going rate to get a flat fixed in Boone. I called AJ's to see if the cost compared and it was no competition. AJ's said they would come out to my car, put some air in the tire, then let me follow them back to the shop to plug it..all for $10. When they were finished fixing it, they told me it would just be 5 bucks. These people are great and I won't go anywhere else in the future!

reviews.author: Ben Karriker
reviews.text: Ajs is a great place! I always have a great time for reasonable price. Always have been honest and kind to me every time I am there! I strongly recommend this place if you need anything done.

reviews.author: Otia Sutton
reviews.text: This place is awesome! The lady at the front desk helped me right away! I'm from Charlotte and go to school at ASU and having car issues hours away from home can be scary! So I'm glade I had her to help me and calm my nerves lol little do she know! I will return definitely if I have any more car issues while at school!

reviews.author: Emma Getz
reviews.text: Super thankful for AJ’s! I have had a lot of car trouble in the past few months but they have always gotten me in super quick and have done a great job. I definitely recommend AJ’s- thank y’all so much!!

reviews.author: Eric Farthing
reviews.text: I use AJ's Tire and Auto frequently for oil changes, service, and repairs. They have delivered consistently good service, and have recommended against repairs that were unnecessary. They will not try to upsell you to repairs/service that aren't needed and are always honest and helpful.

reviews.author: Martin
reviews.text: While we normally use our local Honda dealer, my student needed auto maintenance before returning home. This shop is top notch!

reviews.author: Kailey K
reviews.text: Very disappointed! I trusted AJs to check out an oil leak, and left my car there for a few days while I was out of town. I called AJs myself the day I was planning on returning to pay and have them leave my keys locked up in my car. When I returned that night, my car was not in the parking lot for AJs. After calling the non emergency police line, we found my car in a nearby parking lot because an employee forgot to move my car back. Not only did said employee not leave my car in the right place causing panic that my car had been stolen, he left my car unlocked with the keys in it and a window rolled down!!!!!!!! There are now ants in my car from the tree it was parked under!!! I am honestly surprised my car wasn’t stolen considering how easy it would have been to steal it. I feel like as mechanics they are honest people, but apparently have no respect for how they treat your property.

reviews.author: Paul Gronke
reviews.text: I have had nothing but good experiences with AJ's. I came to Boone on a two year teaching appointment and drove across the country with a 20 year old Subaru wagon that I needed to either keep running, or else get an honest answer about whether it was time to get rid of it. AJ's kept it in good running order the whole time. In fact the only time I had some "problems" with AJ's is when I had a fuel feed problem, the car kept dying at unpredictable times. AJ's didn't want to start to replace parts until they could replicate the problem at the shop, but much as they tried, they could not. I finally had to convince them to start with the fuel pump (fixed it part way) then mass air filter (running like a champ). What kind of shop is actually reluctant to start to perform repairs until they are sure they know the problem? An honest and fair one, in my book. I'd recommend them to anyone. Great shop, great service, friendly people.

reviews.author: Susanna Powers
reviews.text: For its annual inspection required by the state, my 2008 RAV4 always goes to AJ's. They're the only place in town that performs the emissions test for older cars, but they're friendly, it's easy to get an appointment, and the cost is reasonable. My car and I always leave smiling!

reviews.author: Jannie Dixon
reviews.text: I love AJ's Tire!!! Absolutely the best service from the best people in the tire business in Boone!! The people that work there are amazing, knowledgeable, and helpful! The best tires ever for the lowest prices...... What's not to LOVE about AJ's. Don't mess with the rest, go see the best!

reviews.author: Debbie Greene
reviews.text: AJ and his staff have always treated me and my husband like family. They have worked with us and saved us lots of money and troubles with our vehicles. If you want the best deal in town, or the best mechanics in town, call AJ's Tire and Auto. My name is Debbie Greene and my husband is Joe Greene. And we support the staff at AJs.

reviews.author: Dakota Westbrook
reviews.text: My girlfriend went here to get her tires looked at and to try and figure out the source of a mysterious smell. AJ's told her she had a head gasket leak and ball joint issue, and it would be $2400 to fix. She went to get a second and third opinion, and found that she had neither a head gasket leak or ball joint issue. She was able to get a minor oil leak fixed for $15. If you are a young women or anyone who isn't car savvy, expect AJ's to try and take advantage of you.

reviews.author: Allison Peele
reviews.text: Aj and his staff are always very helpful with their service. They always make.sure they consult the customer before completing work. The environment is always very pleasant and family friendly. As a student, I don't trust any other shop in the High Country.

reviews.author: Michelle Freeze
reviews.text: Erica was great, service was wonderful. Mechanics are cranky and gruff (not AJ). Didn't need a second amendment sermon from the signs completely plastering the waiting area, not the most professional look, but fly your freak flag I guess.

reviews.author: Cheryl Alberti
reviews.text: Don't hesitate to bring your car needs to AJ's! To me honesty and car knowledge are the most important qualities of a shop. AJ's is that and more. I can tell you that AJ, Amber and Brian were a pleasure to deal with. I was a stressed parent of an APP student with a possible surprise repair and each of them made me feel like I was a priority to them. When Amber said we will take care of your son, it was not just words. It is very rare to find a place where their customer service and honesty makes you feel like family. Thank you so much for your help.

reviews.author: Meghan Lynch
reviews.text: I had an emergency situation with my car when I was visiting boone this past weekend. The tow man recommended AJ's and I'm so glad he did. They treated me with respect and dignity the whole time and never talked down to me. My car ended up being junked but AJ didn't charge me for any diagnostic and helped me find a junk yard that would buy my car. If I lived in boone, I would go nowhere else and I wish I had someone like him in my town. Highly recommend him.

reviews.author: Stacie Jo Taylor
reviews.text: Just called A J's for a quote for my college student and spoke with Travis. I have not met them as of yet, I am 8 counties away, but Travis is very nice and extremely helpful. My son has an appointment next week and I could not be more pleased at how helpful he was over the phone. Thanks TRAVIS!

reviews.author: Kathy Miller
reviews.text: I Take my vehicles to AJ's .. These guys have experience and knowledge to keep vehicles safe and in great running shape. All the guys there are friendly and courteous. They will go out of their way to help you.

reviews.author: Tehan McMahon
reviews.text: Everyone who works there is super nice. Didn't even charge me for replacing headlights and refilling washer fluid. They're great!

reviews.author: Mike Goddard
reviews.text: I have had maintenance and emergency repair work done on my truck and car at A J's and he is an owner operator and is there all the time. I find the auto tech's are knowable and explained the problems thoroughly allowing me to make the best decision that fit the budget and did not leave me worried about repeated problems. I would send my mother and daughter to their shop and do not feel they would try and dupe them into unnecessary repairs or extras.

reviews.author: Forest Shepherd
reviews.text: My story for this location is as follows: I towed my car to their shop and asked them to look over it and determine what needs to be done to get it running and if they see anything else that needs to be fixed. They said sure... -I came back and they told me that I would need to replace all my brakes, rotor, and calipers, as well as my belts. Cost: ~$1700 (the guy actually told me that when he test drove my car that he had no brakes and he was rolling through stop lights praying he lives) I accepted what they said, but did not have the funds to fix all of those repairs. -After towing my car home I charged the battery and drove around my parking lot. I was able to stop...but it was difficult. -I took out a loan at the beginning of my grad program and took my car to the friendship honda dealership of boone in town. They gave me a similar estimate ~$1800 BUT they told me that I would only need to change my front brakes and rotors, also they found out I had no air bags and no occupant detection system, they also found out why my brakes were bad. It was not what AJ had quoted at all...It was my master cylinder. I also had a idle air sensor that was bad and that was the reason my car would rev up and down when I started it. They also added a new ignition key <-(cant remember the name of that part right now). The total was ~$1800. IF I HAD TRUSTED THESE BULLS**T MECHANIC'S AT AJ'S I WOULD HAVE BEEN OUT $1700 AND WOULD HAVE FIXED THINGS THAT DID NOT EVEN NEED FIXING. !!STUDENTS!! BE CAREFUL WITH THESE GUYS, JUST DO NOT TRUST THESE PEOPLE. OH and just to let the people reading this know: I had to drive to Kansas for grad school and after the friendship honda shop took care of my car I had not problem getting here and I am driving to Denver, CO this weekend and don't foresee any problems or have fear that my car will not make it. AGAIN DON'T BLINDLY TRUST THESE GUYS OR THEY WILL PICKPOCKET YOU FOR PARTS YOU DON'T EVEN NEED. INEXPERIENCE = AJ'S

reviews.author: Thel Kelejian
reviews.text: They do what mechanics are supposed to do, but not much more than that. Little consideration is given to the customer's convenience. Communication is poor and the staff is haughty. With a handful of disappointing visits to this shop, I will unfortunately be taking my car elsewhere from now on.

reviews.author: Fellowship Administrator
reviews.text: AJ's is the only shop in Boone that doesn't push extra work. They advise you of issues that you might see in the coming months. I have tried 3 other shops in the past 12 years....I know that AJ's is who treats me fair. I call them "the working man's friend".

reviews.author: Laura blossom
reviews.text: They act like nice helpful poeple and there prices are so great because they dont tell you you need an alignment before you put 4 new tires on. I have taken my car here many times and had great service and then my tires went bad in two years and they were very unprofessional and rude and threatening .

reviews.author: Sophie Hatcher
reviews.text: If I could leave more than 5 stars I would! Love this place and recommend it to anyone who needs work done on their vehicle. Great place to get tires!!

reviews.author: Nathan Bush
reviews.text: I walked in to find two employees talking to one another. I stood there politely waiting for someone to acknowledge me, but no one ever did. I couldn’t believe it actually happened. I would not recommend this shop to anyone looking for good customer service.

reviews.author: B Hat
reviews.text: DO NOT GIVE THEM YOUR BUSINESS. I had a routine brake job done less than 3 months ago (pads and rotors replaced) and because they did not lubricate the caliper correctly one of the brakes stuck and ended up burning up the pad and tearing up the rotor. My wheel was locking on me as i was driving. I scheduled an appointment and without even looking at my wheel the mechanic said that it wasn't their fault and that i had to come back later, and that they didnt have any record of me getting work done. The mechanic was aggressive with me and refused to do anything for me. He insisted that if i wanted the caliper, pads and rotors replaced that i would have to come in 5 hours later and pay full price. This is the worst service ive ever experienced. I am a college student who cant afford to pay for a brake job twice, and even worse they broke my caliper! After speaking with multiple other people, i was informed that they had this exact same experience with breaking parts and not even looking at them.

reviews.author: William Hamlin
reviews.text: My daughter's 2004 Mazda 6 broke down on I-85 while returning to App State on the Sunday following Thanksgiving. I had her car towed to AJ's. AJ's started working on the car Monday morning and quickly determined that the cause was a blown spark plug. The plug had actually separated itself from the engine. AJ's had to order some parts and the car was repaired by Wednesday morning. The repair cost was exceptionally reasonable. I had researched this mechanical problem and made note of the average repair costs. AJ's was well below the average cost for this repair.

reviews.author: Amber
reviews.text: I have been using them for a few years now and they are always honest with prices and their work! I recommend them to anyone who needs work done on their car

reviews.author: Skyler
reviews.text: Very kind people!!!! They don't over charge or lie about what needs to be done like some places. Whenever I've taken my car to them they have done a wonderful job

reviews.author: Dustin Eaton
reviews.text: Fast, quality service here. Extremely friendly and honest people all around. Probably the best auto shop experience I’ve ever had.

reviews.author: Chad Burman
reviews.text: This is a QUALITY/TRUSTWORTHY shop who I have been going to since I moved to the area. They were recommended and in my experience I can see why.

reviews.author: Ashley
reviews.text: AJ's continues to be the absolute best. They provide such excellent service, at such a fair price, and their staff is so friendly and helpful. Thank you guys!!

reviews.author: Tori McLean
reviews.text: AJ's Tire & Auto have some great guys, know what they are doing, do everything in the timely manner in which they say it will take, and do an amazing job on fixing everything that's wrong with your vehicle! I appreciate all the guys up there at AJ's

reviews.author: Tyler McDonald
reviews.text: Been going to this shop for years. And for good reason. They have always done a great job, have always shot straight, and have always offered fair prices and understanding.

reviews.author: Barry Hauptman
reviews.text: In Boone on vacation. Showed up unannounced...greeted,repaired and replaced , no attempt to upsell and charges were crazy inexpensive. Strong recommendation. Thx!

reviews.author: Michael Bennett
reviews.text: Always kind always reasonable for work completed. If I had a daughter would feel comfortable sending her here it is that kind of place.

reviews.author: Daron merritt
reviews.text: Went to AJ's this morning with a leak in one of my tires. They took care of me right away and was super friendly.. Thanks for your hospitality!!!

reviews.author: Sue Barker
reviews.text: Hear nothing but GREAT things about this place. This is why I give them 5 stars. I know that helped a lady that locked her keys and sweets ones in her van one time for free.

reviews.author: Angie Andrews
reviews.text: Never fails to amaze me with the professionalism and expertise. Thank u and Brian so much for getting the Pathfinder fixed. You all are the best!!

reviews.author: Thomas Studnicky
reviews.text: I’ve been here a few times for inspections, oil changes, and new tires. Every time they’ve been great with starting work right away and had good prices too.

reviews.author: EGKunz
reviews.text: Fast and polite customer service. The wait times are short and they never try to gouge you on prices. Their quotes are always fair.

reviews.author: Megan Hathaway
reviews.text: The BEST tire and service business around!!! If you are looking for a fair, friendly, quality repair/experience-this is the place for you! AJ is absolutely amazing!

reviews.author: Scott Doty
reviews.text: Best place in the High Country for oil changes, state inspections and engine repairs! VERY BEST PLACE IN THE HIGH COUNTRY (OR EVEN OFF THE MOUNTAIN) FOR TIRES! BEST PRICE ANYWHERE! LOCAL BUSINESS!!!

reviews.author: Fugazi
reviews.text: Friendly and helpful service, they make sure you know what you're paying for before work is started, competitive labor rates and parts prices.

reviews.author: brian forchheimer
reviews.text: Always been a straight up shop. Honest, integrity, and respect. Thank you for keeping my daughters car on the road.

reviews.author: Savas Altuntas
reviews.text: The service is very good but it’s hard to get an appointment and it can take a long time to service your car.

reviews.author: Cyrus Patel
reviews.text: Awesome place that helped us out when they weren't even open yet due to us being pressed for time. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: jason campbell
reviews.text: A solid repair shop, trusted by locals. I have been doing business with AJ's for years now with no problems.

reviews.author: Timothy Corum
reviews.text: Willing to help you get your ride improved or back running at a price that college students and locals can afford.

reviews.author: Kevin Farrell
reviews.text: i'll save repeating and say that I'd add five more stars for a total of 10 if I could. decent, honest, nice folks.

reviews.author: Tom Rooney
reviews.text: Damaged my fiero when I took it here. I told them what would happen if lifted wrong. They did just that then argued that was not the cause

reviews.author: Fritzi Goins
reviews.text: Great ppl who will tell you the truth about what is wrong and if you need to be aware of a issue that you don't know is wrong.
